verdict.rationale: Sardine markets in-product 'Agentic AML Ops' with 'audit-ready agents' that automate KYC/AML alert reviews and speed up investigations. Its sanctions AI agents perform supporting research, clear false positives and route matches to analysts, all within a case management workspace for reviewing alerts. The evidence is marketing-level only: it never explicitly covers transaction-monitoring alerts, and 'audit-ready' only implies that agents draft review notes. Missing for 10: explicit agent coverage of transaction-monitoring alerts, documented generation of review notes or case narratives, in-depth first-party docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
